name: Xperia Z5

images.credit: April.Kai, CC BY-SA 4.0 via Wikimedia Commons

Launch.Predecessor: Sony Xperia Z3+ (Global), Sony Xperia Z4 SO-03G (Japan), Sony Xperia Z4 402SO (Japan), Sony Xperia Z4 SOV31 (Japan)

Body.Dimensions: 146 mm H, 72 mm W, 7.3 mm D

Platform.Operating system: Android 5.1.1 Lollipop Upgradable to Android 7.1.1 Nougat
Platform.CPU: Octa-core 64-bit 20 nm, • Quad-core 2.0 GHz Cortex-A57, • Quad-core 1.5 GHz Cortex A-53

Display.Display: 5.2 in 1080p IPS LCD, Full HD 1920x1080 px, TRILUMINOS™ Display with Live Color LED, X-Reality Engine for Mobile , Dynamic Contrast Enhancer

Cameras.Rear camera: 23 MP [Exmor RS IMX300],1/2.3" sensor size, back-side illuminated sensor, LED flash, 4K (2160p) video recording @ 30 fps, 1080p@60fps, 720p@120fps, 0.03 seconds Hybrid Autofocus
Cameras.Front camera: 5 MP [Exmor R IMX241],1/5" sensor size, 1080p video recording @ 30 fps, 720p@60fps

Connectivity.Connectivity: Wi-Fi, DLNA, GPS/GLONASS/BeiDou, NFC, Bluetooth 4.1, MHL 3.0, USB 2.0 (Micro-B port, USB charging, Quick Charge 2.0), USB OTG, 3.50 mm headphone jack, 5 pole, fingerprint sensor
